items.title: Australian 'lived normal life' before allegedly dumping Thai teen's body
items.description: Australian Simon Peter Carman "lived his normal life", going out, washing his clothes and talking to neighbours after allegedly murdering a teenage girl and stuffing her body inside a suitcase in Thailand, police say.

items.title: Live: Liberal MP suspended from parliament for 24 hours after QT outburst
items.description: Liberal MP Garth Hamilton has been suspended from the House of Representatives for 24 hours after an outburst during Question Time. Follow live.

items.title: Uber defends imposing 'disability tax' on riders
items.description: Uber has defended slugging riders who require extra assistance with a "disability tax", amid ongoing criticism over how it treats people with disability.

items.title: As Trump plays dealmaker-in-chief, the reality on the ground is very different
items.description: Two recent Middle East deals, one in Iran and the other in Lebanon, seem at odds with each other, and show how the Trump administration is running different approaches depending on who it is talking to at any given moment.

items.title: Moira Deeming set to be dumped as Liberal candidate after assault allegation
items.description: Controversial MP Moira Deeming is set to be deselected as a Liberal Party candidate for the November state election for refusing to apologise to partyroom colleague Matthew Guy.

items.title: 'No place for the poison of antisemitism': New warning for universities
items.description: The government's Antisemitism Education Taskforce, led by David Gonski, has equipped teachers with new resources to tackle antisemitism and promote "Australian values".

items.title: Rex Airlines breached continuous disclosure obligations
items.description: Rex contravened its continuous disclosure obligations and misled the market, the NSW Supreme Court found on Tuesday.

items.title: These sexual enhancement supplements contain hidden prescription drugs
items.description: The TGA issues a warning for consumers using sexual enhancement products after an investigation finds several products contain undeclared prescription drugs that could have serious side effects.

items.title: Lifeless Germany fall at World Cup as Paraguay show tenacity to die another day
items.description: Paraguay's upset penalty-shootout win over Germany at the World Cup, while stunning, was not entirely unexpected, as they showed impressive determination to die another day.

items.title: Paediatrician accused of child sex offences now facing 53 charges
items.description: A Perth paediatrician accused of using hidden cameras to record himself abusing children is now facing more than 50 charges involving 10 alleged victims, with a court told further charges are likely to be laid.

items.title: Ernst and Young staff sacked as Albanese's banking information allegedly breached
items.description: Two Ernst and Young employees have been sacked after Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's personal banking information was allegedly breached while the pair worked for the accounting firm at the Commonwealth Bank.

items.title: 'MrBeast model': Stefanovic's numbers reveal his broader strategy
items.description: Why is the former king of Australian breakfast television trading studio lights for ring lights?

items.title: Bid to make scam texts easier to detect set to begin
items.description: The changes will come into effect tomorrow and small businesses will need to get in touch with their telco.

items.title: Why Telstra, Optus and TPG mobile coverage maps now look different
items.description: Australia's major telcos are being forced to comply with new standards when promoting mobile coverage networks, and Telstra is not happy.

items.title: Exhibition explores Australia's 'incredible fascination' with Antarctica
items.description: For most, a trip to Antarctica is well beyond reach, but a new exhibition at the National Museum of Australia gives visitors the chance to explore life in one of the most extreme environments on Earth.

items.title: Don't ask me what's culturally appropriate, I don't know either
items.description: After sending out invitations to a belated elopement party, I was suddenly fielding calls from friends who wanted to wear saris but were worried that it might be disrespectful.

items.title: More Australians are doing their own tax returns and making these mistakes
items.description: With side hustles, working from home, crypto investments, renting out rooms and receiving income through digital platforms or apps, experts say people are at greater risk of making errors with their tax.

items.title: Antarctica's first dinosaur fossil found in drawer after 40 years
items.description: A bone found in Antarctica in 1985, and kept in a drawer in England for almost four decades, turns out to belong to one of the largest types of dinosaurs to ever walk the Earth.

items.title: Thunderbirds co-captain to lead 'connected' team in grand final repeat
items.description: The Adelaide Thunderbirds are looking to win their third premiership in four years, with co-captain Georgie Horjus putting their success down to strong team connections on and off the court.

items.title: The government is making major changes to universities. Here's what to expect
items.description: The government will spend an extra $3.6 billion over a decade on new university places, but some are warning the money could be wasted.

items.title: Brisbane protester removed from tree after 23 hours
items.description: Emergency services had to remove a power line to lift the woman down from the tree at Kurilpa Common, a state-owned lot taken over by "guerilla gardeners" during COVID-19.

items.title: North-west Victorian sporting league adopts new concussion app
items.description: A sporting league in regional Victoria is the first to adopt a concussion app aimed at improving communication and accountability around concussions at grassroots sports.

items.title: Suspected saltwater crocodile takes dog at unexpected outback location
items.description: Richmond Shire Mayor John Wharton believes a dog has been taken by a saltwater crocodile in the Flinders River, hundreds of kilometres inland from its usual habitat.

items.title: Five tonnes of antibiotics used to combat disease in salmon
items.description: More than five tonnes of antibiotics were used to treat a disease that killed 9,000 tonnes of fish last summer, Salmon Tasmania says.

items.title: Police say 'miracle' no-one killed as six trucks destroyed in fiery crash
items.description: Police say it is a "miracle" no-one was seriously harmed after six semi-trailers were destroyed by fire after trucks crashed into a rest area south-west of Goulburn.
